description.p: Sets up the leaked DLSS 5 neural-rendering build in DirectX 11 and 12 games running under Steam and Proton: it lists your games, installs the right pieces, checks the model against your card, sets the Proton launch options, and takes it all back out cleanly.
An unofficial, experimental feature. It needs an NVIDIA RTX card, and some game and Proton combinations are unstable.
